components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a context: save, add, create.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: #cba6f7; color: #11111b; font: 500 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(203 166 247 / .5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Header actions such as Nueva rutina and Fijar en inicio.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #313244; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1e1e2e; color: #cdd6f4; font: 500 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #181825; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #cba6f7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(203 166 247 / .5); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Pill input, 36px high; the search field is 40px with a muted fill.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 240px; padding: 4px 16px; border: 1px solid #45475a; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #cdd6f4; font: 400 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a6adc8; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #cba6f7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(203 166 247 / .5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat pane with a 1px border and 21.6px corners; the border darkens on hover.
components.html:
Tareas flash · Hoy 2/5
Terminar el informe
components.css: .ds-card { width: 260px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #313244; border-radius: 21.6px; background: #1e1e2e; color: #cdd6f4; font: 400 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgb(205 214 244 / .3); } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-text { color: #a6adc8; }

components.name: Day Check
components.description: The routine toggle: bordered circle when pending, Mauve with a check when done.

components.css: .ds-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid rgb(166 173 200 / .8); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #11111b; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-check:hover { background: #181825; } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cba6f7; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-check-done { border-color: #cba6f7; background: #cba6f7; }

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: Semana / Mes view switch; the active option uses the Surface fill, not Mauve.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #313244; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-seg button { padding: 4px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #a6adc8; font: 400 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #cdd6f4; } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background: #313244; color: #cdd6f4; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar row: 14px Subtext with an icon; active row fills Surface.
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 224px; padding: 8px; background: #181825; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 9.6px; color: #a6adc8; font: 400 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #313244; color: #cdd6f4; } .ds-nav-active { background: #313244; color: #cdd6f4; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview:
SnapNote is the screen a student or developer keeps open all day. Home works like a cockpit: pinned notes, today's flash tasks, today's routines, the calendar and the running Pomodoro sit together as small instruments you can read at a glance and use without leaving the page. Every other page is the full-size version of one of those instruments.

The cockpit is calm and flat. Colors come from Catppuccin: Mocha in dark (the default theme) and Latte in light. Surfaces are flat panes separated by 1px borders, never by shadow or blur, and every control is a pill or a generously rounded card, in the manner of Ollama's interface. One accent, Mauve, lights up only when something is done, active or focused. The one place with full color is code, which renders in VS Code's Dark+ and Light+ token palettes.
keyCharacteristics: Catppuccin Mocha / Latte neutrals with a single Mauve accent; no gradients, no blur, no acrylic.
Flat 1px-bordered cards (21.6px corners) and pill-shaped buttons, inputs and selects.
System sans for everything, monospace only inside code; Phosphor icons throughout.
Compact controls (28-36px) that stay quiet until hover.
Small pinned mini-cards on Home as read-and-act instruments.
Code blocks in true VS Code colors, inside notes and on cards.
Friendly details: emoji folders and routine icons, plain Spanish copy.

rules.name: The Lit-When-Done Rule
rules.body: Mauve appears only on completed, active or focused things, plus the single primary button. A mauve that is just decoration is a bug. "Today" is never mauve: it is marked with inverted text color.

rules.name: The Code Keeps Its Colors Rule
rules.body: Syntax colors never leak into the interface, and the interface palette never recolors code.

rules.name: The Both-Themes Rule
rules.body: Every color is defined for Mocha and Latte. Unchecked control borders sit at 80% of the subtext color so they hold 3:1 against the page in both themes.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Only the system sans and the code mono. No second UI face, no decorative display face, no CDN fonts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only shadow in the system is the soft Floating shadow on layers that sit above the page. Hover on cards darkens the border; it never adds a shadow.

dos: Do keep Mauve for done, active, focused and the single primary button.
Do mark "today" with inverted text color, never with Mauve.
Do define every color for Mocha and Latte, and design dark first.
Do make buttons, inputs, selects and chips pills, and cards 21.6px with a 1px border.
Do separate surfaces with a border; keep depth to the Floating shadow on layers above the page.
Do make anything pinnable usable in its mini-card form on Home.
Do give every icon button a tooltip in Spanish, plus its shortcut when one exists.
Do render code with the --code-* tokens and the 20px mono line.
Do use Phosphor icons in the regular weight, fill only to mark the active item or a lit streak.
Do keep text at 12px or larger, and touch targets at 44px where the layout is touch-first.
donts: Don't add a second accent color, gradients, glows or blur to panes, text or controls.
Don't use hard or colored shadows.
Don't put code on a translucent surface or recolor it with interface colors.
Don't add a second UI font or CDN-loaded fonts.
Don't mix icon families; interface icons come from Phosphor (routine and folder icons are user-chosen emoji).
Don't let a view switch, a header action or "today" borrow the Mauve reserved for done.
Don't turn SnapNote into a pixel copy of Notion or Ollama; the cockpit structure, mini-cards, day-based tools and code surfaces carry the identity.
